doc.summary: Compact JSON payload embedding for self-contained HTML pages.
doc.description:
Large pages embed their data as one JSON document. Generated API data
is highly repetitive (file paths, kinds, signatures, parameter names),
so payloads above PAYLOAD_COMPRESSION_MIN_BYTES are gzip-compressed and
base64-encoded into the script tag. The page decodes them offline with
the browser's native DecompressionStream: zero dependencies, zero
requests, and it works from file:// as well as static hosting.
Small payloads stay plain JSON so they remain greppable.

name: PAYLOAD_LOADER_JS
escape_json_for_script
signature: def escape_json_for_script(text: str, chars: str = '<>&') -> str

doc.summary: Escape JSON text so it can never close or confuse a script element.

params.name: chars
params.description: Characters to unicode-escape; "<" is always included.

returns.description: JSON text with the requested characters unicode-escaped.

name: should_compress
signature: def should_compress(raw_size: int, config: Config) -> bool

doc.summary: Decide whether a payload of raw_size bytes gets compressed.

params.name: raw_size
params.description: Size of the serialized JSON in UTF-8 bytes.

returns.description: True when compression is enabled and the payload reaches the threshold.

name: compress_text
signature: def compress_text(text: str, config: Config) -> str

doc.summary: Gzip and base64-encode text deterministically (mtime fixed at zero).

returns.description: ASCII base64 string of the gzip stream.

name: payload_script
signature: def payload_script(element_id: str, payload: object, config: Config, compact: bool = True, escape: str = '<>&') -> str

doc.summary: Render the script element carrying a page payload.
doc.description:
Plain payloads keep the exact serialization each page used before
(separators and escaped characters), so small pages are unchanged.

params.name: element_id
params.description: DOM id the page loader reads.

params.name: compact
params.description: True for "," / ":" separators, False for json.dumps defaults.

params.name: escape
params.description: Characters unicode-escaped in plain JSON ("<" always is).

returns.description:
A plain application/json script element, or a gzip+base64
application/octet-stream element when the payload is large.

name: read_payload_script
signature: def read_payload_script(document: str, element_id: str) -> Optional[object]

doc.summary: Decode a payload script element from a rendered page (plain or gzip+base64).

params.name: element_id
params.description: DOM id of the payload script element.

returns.description: The decoded JSON value, or None when the element is missing or empty.
